title: 41% of America's land is home to no one
description: A paper map of the US with every 2020 Census block that has zero residents cut out of it: 2.1 million of the 7.9 million blocks with any land. The East stays mostly solid; the West is more hole than paper. Nevada is the emptiest state (77% of its land), Connecticut the fullest (5%). Pick any state to see its holes up close, county by county. Data: US Census Bureau, 2020 Census blocks (TIGER/Line).
